title: Eval Runner Output Schema
description: JSON Schema for the output artifact produced by a future eval runner when executing an eval suite against a skill. This schema is the contract that eval runner implementations must conform to. No actual runner is invoked for this static fixture; the schema defines the expected shape for future integration.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Increment when the contract shape changes in a backwards-incompatible way.

contract_version.description: Semantic contract version. Tracks the runner output contract independently of the eval suite version.

name.description: Identifier of the eval runner implementation.

version.description: Semantic version of the runner implementation.

mode.description: Execution mode. 'static' = deterministic fixture-based (no LLM). 'live' = actual skill execution with possible LLM grading.

skill.description: Name of the skill under evaluation.

skill_version.description: Version or commit ref of the skill under evaluation.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the eval run started.

finished_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the eval run finished.

eval_results.description: Per-eval-case results. One entry per eval case in evals.json.

failure_reason_shape.description: Documents the shape of failure findings when assertions fail.

comparison_metadata.description: Metadata for future with-skill vs without-skill comparison. Populated only when comparison mode is active.

paired_run_id.description: ID of the paired run (with-skill or without-skill) for comparison.

baseline_pass_rate.description: Baseline pass rate from the paired run.

current_pass_rate.description: Pass rate of the current run.

eval_id.description: Matches the eval case ID from evals.json.

status.description: Overall eval case status. PASS = all assertions passed. FAIL = at least one assertion failed. ERROR = runner could not execute the eval case.

assertion_details.description: Per-assertion results for this eval case.

type.description: Assertion type, matching the enum in evals.json.

actual.description: Actual value observed by the runner. May be empty for trigger/anti-trigger checks.

eval_count.description: Total number of eval cases executed.

evals_passed.description: Number of eval cases with status PASS.

evals_failed.description: Number of eval cases with status FAIL or ERROR.

assertions_total.description: Total assertions across all eval cases.

status.description: Overall run status. PASS = all evals passed. FAIL = at least one eval failed.
